name: card-field

frames.best_why: Shows the completed row with last-four number, expiry and security code, plus the enabled pay button.

tagline: Card input where the number folds to its last four, opening room for expiry.
summary: A single-row checkout field for card number, expiry and security code. The number groups as you type, then collapses to its last four so the other fields fit beside it.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds a small Card heading, a Use test card link and one inset row with a brand badge, grouped digits, MM / YY and CVC, plus a hint line and a wide pay button below.
behaviour: Typing digits groups the number in fours, and a valid full number slides away to its last four while expiry and security code appear in the same row. The pay button shifts from a dim idle tone to white once the form is complete.
demo_content: A test Visa 4242 paying $48.00, expiry 04/28 and security code 123.
search_phrases: card number input with expiry and cvc
card number that shows last four digits
payment card form with brand logo
inline expiry and security code input
use_when: A checkout needs the card number, expiry and code in one compact row.
avoid_when: The test-card helper and hardcoded zinc palette suit demos; real payment handling still needs a processor.
customise: Amount, currency, a payment callback and test mode are props; the card layout, brand detection and colour palette are written in the source.
weight_why: A single card row with a few motion values; no loop and no heavy drawing.

a11y.note: Fields are labelled and announce brand and payment state; motion respects reduced-motion.

polish_why: Clever collapsing number with clear states and a tidy dark card.
title: Card Field
